definition: Stable identity for one complete immutable release bundle.
release_validation: Recompute from release spec, universe, profile/evidence versions, input manifest, generator, rules, and serialization hashes.
interpretation_boundary: Release identity contains no target assessment.

definition: Version of the release contract.
release_validation: Exact controlled value.
interpretation_boundary: Spec versions are not evidence maturity levels.

definition: Lifecycle state of the immutable release bundle.
release_validation: RELEASED only after every MUST QC gate passes; failures produce WITHHELD.
interpretation_boundary: Release status does not state target quality.

definition: Universe family used for this materialization.
release_validation: Must resolve to the target manifest artifact.
interpretation_boundary: Universe membership is scope, not target selection.

definition: Immutable universe snapshot version.
release_validation: Must match every released profile input manifest.
interpretation_boundary: A universe version does not imply scientific merit.

definition: Hash covering every input artifact, version, rule, and query scope.
release_validation: Recompute before and after materialization.
interpretation_boundary: A hash establishes identity, not validity.

definition: Artifact identifier for the complete release QC results.
release_validation: Must resolve to one frozen QC artifact.
interpretation_boundary: QC provenance is not evidence about a target.

definition: Hash of the complete release QC results.
release_validation: Must match the governed QC artifact.
interpretation_boundary: Passing software QC does not validate biology.

definition: Stable identity for one target under one profile/evidence snapshot.
release_validation: SHA256(EnsemblID|profile_version|evidence_snapshot_version|input_manifest_sha256|rules_sha256).
interpretation_boundary: Identity is not an assessment.

definition: Only entity and join key.
release_validation: Exact byte-for-byte match to one included target-manifest row; unique among profiles.
interpretation_boundary: Symbol cannot replace or repair it.

definition: Version of profile structure and component interpretation semantics.
release_validation: Changes whenever required/optional fields or interpretation semantics change.
interpretation_boundary: A newer profile version is not a better target.

definition: Version identifying the exact evidence, source releases, query scopes, and hashes.
release_validation: Derived from canonical ordered evidence artifact IDs/hashes and source versions.
interpretation_boundary: Snapshot recency is not evidence strength.

definition: Component represented by this long-form row.
release_validation: Exactly 11 unique component rows per profile in frozen order.
interpretation_boundary: Components are organizational blocks, not votes.

definition: Evidence availability/uncertainty state.
release_validation: Exactly one state per component under frozen precedence.
interpretation_boundary: States are non-numerical and not favorable/unfavorable.

definition: Exact rule that resolved the component state.
release_validation: Must resolve to tested code/configuration and the Task #021 semantic predicate.
interpretation_boundary: Free-text or LLM judgment cannot resolve state.

definition: Version of the state-resolution implementation.
release_validation: Must match release-level rules artifact and hash.
interpretation_boundary: Rule version is provenance, not confidence.

definition: Traceable explanation of the satisfied predicate and unresolved limitations.
release_validation: Generated by a frozen template; must cite linked IDs and cannot exceed evidence meaning.
interpretation_boundary: No therapeutic conclusion permitted.

definition: Bounded claim identifiers linked to the component.
release_validation: Unique, lexically sorted, and resolvable to EnsemblID/component domains.
interpretation_boundary: Claim count is not evidence strength.

definition: Atomic evidence records represented by the component.
release_validation: Unique, sorted, and each record resolves through a claim to the same EnsemblID.
interpretation_boundary: Records are not independent votes.

definition: Source entities underlying linked records.
release_validation: Every observed record resolves to one source entity.
interpretation_boundary: Different sources may remain dependent.

definition: Explicit source release/version for linked records.
release_validation: One entry per source ID; UNKNOWN blocks provenance_complete=TRUE.
interpretation_boundary: A version does not establish quality.

definition: Artifacts required to reconstruct component evidence.
release_validation: Unique and sorted; includes claims, records, sources, dependencies, rules, and source data as applicable.
interpretation_boundary: Artifact count is not evidence quantity.

definition: Explicit artifact-to-hash mapping.
release_validation: Exactly one verified hash per artifact ID; positional unpaired hash lists are prohibited.
interpretation_boundary: Hashes do not establish scientific validity.

definition: Exact record-level missingness mapping.
release_validation: Every evidence_record_id appears exactly once with OBSERVED, NOT_FOUND, NOT_QUERIED, NOT_APPLICABLE, or UNKNOWN.
interpretation_boundary: Missingness is not negative evidence.

definition: Exact record-level uncertainty mapping.
release_validation: Every evidence_record_id maps to its controlled source uncertainty.
interpretation_boundary: Uncertainty is not a numerical penalty.

definition: Exact dependency edges induced among component records.
release_validation: Every edge resolves to two linked evidence_record_ids; no edge is inferred or omitted.
interpretation_boundary: No edge does not prove independence.

definition: Exact edge-to-relationship mapping.
release_validation: One mapping per dependency_edge_id.
interpretation_boundary: Relationships are not numerical weights.

definition: Exact edge-to-qualitative dependency level mapping.
release_validation: One mapping per dependency_edge_id; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.
interpretation_boundary: Dependency level is not a score.

definition: Whether a material conflict is documented.
release_validation: Must reconcile with component_state and conflict IDs.
interpretation_boundary: FALSE means no defined conflict found, not universal agreement.

definition: Records participating in a component conflict.
release_validation: Required when conflict_present=TRUE; subset of evidence_record_ids.
interpretation_boundary: Conflicting records cannot be discarded or averaged away.

definition: Bounded description of the conflict and comparison scope.
release_validation: Required for TRUE; NONE otherwise unless UNKNOWN needs an explicit limitation.
interpretation_boundary: Does not choose a preferred record.

definition: Whether minimum component provenance is present.
release_validation: TRUE requires complete record/source/artifact/rule mappings.
interpretation_boundary: Complete provenance does not mean strong evidence.

definition: Audit count of linked atomic records.
release_validation: Must equal the number of non-NONE record IDs.
interpretation_boundary: Quantity is not quality or independence.

definition: Audit count whose record-level state is OBSERVED.
release_validation: Must not exceed evidence_record_count.
interpretation_boundary: More observed records do not imply stronger support.

definition: What evidence is characterized and what remains unresolved.
release_validation: Cannot change component_state or aggregate components.
interpretation_boundary: Maturity is availability, not target quality.

definition: Identity of the materialization generator.
release_validation: Must resolve to source-controlled code.
interpretation_boundary: Generator identity does not validate scientific logic.

definition: Version of materialization behavior.
release_validation: Exact value frozen before generation.
interpretation_boundary: Version is not evidence maturity.

definition: Content hash of executed generator.
release_validation: Must match the executed file.
interpretation_boundary: A hash does not prove correct logic.

definition: Hash covering executable state and rationale rules.
release_validation: Used in profile_id and verified before/after generation.
interpretation_boundary: Rules cannot contain hidden aggregation.

definition: Materialization snapshot time.
release_validation: Copied from configuration; wall clock cannot alter rows.
interpretation_boundary: Recency is not relevance.

definition: Canonical output-format version.
release_validation: Controls header, row order, quoting, lists, booleans, integers, and sentinels.
interpretation_boundary: Format does not change evidence meaning.

definition: Human-readable display annotation.
release_validation: Copied after EnsemblID joins; never used as a key or repair.
interpretation_boundary: Symbol is not identity.

definition: Source-provided gene-type display annotation.
release_validation: Copied without recoding; cannot alter component state.
interpretation_boundary: Gene type does not imply relevance or druggability.

definition: Display-only external identifiers with their source/status.
release_validation: No symbol inference; ambiguous and missing mappings remain explicit.
interpretation_boundary: External IDs do not replace EnsemblID.

definition: Non-interpretive display clarification.
release_validation: Cannot introduce claims, ordering, recommendations, or therapeutic meaning.
interpretation_boundary: Presentation only.

definition: Any numerical or categorical target score.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: No scoring in evidence profiles.

definition: Any target ordering field.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: No ranking in evidence profiles.

definition: Any priority label or tier.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: No prioritization in evidence profiles.

definition: Any recommendation field.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: No target recommendation.

definition: Any target selection decision.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: Universe membership is not selection.

definition: Any inferred therapeutic mechanism direction.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: No therapeutic-direction inference.

definition: Any combined overall profile state.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: Components cannot be collapsed into one judgment.

definition: Any combined confidence metric.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: Uncertainty cannot become a hidden score.

definition: Any profile-completeness percentage.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: Completeness is not quality.

definition: Any count treating records/domains as independent votes.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: Independence requires explicit reviewed lineage.

definition: Any progress/stop or development decision.
release_validation: Header/value absence required.
interpretation_boundary: Evidence organization is separate from decisions.
